stemMarkdown: The average of 6 numbers is 44. When one more number is included, the average becomes the sum of all 7 numbers divided by 7. If the new number added is 70, find the new average (rounded to 2 decimal places).
solutionMarkdown: Sum of original 6 numbers $= 6 \times 44 = 264$. New sum $= 264 + 70 = 334$. New average $= \dfrac{334}{7} = 47.71$.
